name: Bemegride
summary: Bemegride, sold under the brand name Megimide among others, is a central nervous system (CNS) stimulant first manufactured in 1911, and which has been used in hypnotic overdose.

pharmacology.text: As with other chemoreceptor agonists, it is a potent emetic at doses above those normally used in management of barbiturate overdose, although vomiting and aspiration are a concern during treatment.

uses.text: As with other chemoreceptor agonists, it is a potent emetic at doses above those normally used in management of barbiturate overdose, although vomiting and aspiration are a concern during treatment. It is a controlled substance in some countries, and is sometimes used to induce convulsions in experimental animals.

summaryZh: 貝美格是一種含氮有機化合物，分子式C8H13NO2，屬於戊二醯亞胺衍生物，能作為中樞神經系統興奮劑，1911年首次合成。
summaryZhHans: 贝美格是一种含氮有机化合物，分子式C8H13NO2，属于戊二酰亚胺衍生物，能作为中枢神经系统兴奋剂，1911年首次合成。

sideEffects.en: It causes vomiting, muscle twitching, agitation and convulsions, and it can trigger seizures. This is why it is no longer used in treating overdose.
sideEffects.zh: 它會造成嘔吐、肌肉抽動、躁動與抽搐，並可能誘發癲癇發作。這正是它不再用於治療藥物過量的原因。
sideEffects.zhHans: 它会造成呕吐、肌肉抽动、躁动与抽搐，并可能诱发癫痫发作。这正是它不再用于治疗药物过量的原因。

fact.en: It was once given to wake people from barbiturate overdose, a practice now abandoned because such analeptics cause seizures and do not actually reverse the poisoning.
fact.zh: 貝美格曾被用來喚醒巴比妥過量的患者，但這種做法已被放棄，因為這類甦醒劑會引起癲癇發作，而且並不能真正逆轉中毒。
fact.zhHans: 贝美格曾被用来唤醒巴比妥过量的患者，但这种做法已被放弃，因为这类苏醒剂会引起癫痫发作，而且并不能真正逆转中毒。
